## Overview of the request path

`POST /api/owners` is served by **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner(...)`**. The controller class implements the OpenAPI-generated `OwnersApi` interface, which carries all the HTTP mapping and parameter-binding/validation annotations. The V2 controller (`OwnerRestControllerV2`) has no create method — it only adds `GET /api/owners` paging (`listOwnersPage`), so it is irrelevant to create.

Execution order end-to-end: Security filter chain → argument binding + Bean Validation on the DTO → `@PreAuthorize` method security → controller `addOwner` → idempotency check → `createNewOwner` pipeline → MapStruct mapping → normalization/validation gates → capacity gates → household resolution → derived-attribute assignment → `clinicService.saveOwner` (JPA) → audit log → response with `Location` header. public ResponseEntity<OwnerDto> addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto, String idempotencyKey) {
    boolean hasKey = idempotencyKey != null && !idempotencyKey.isBlank();
    if (hasKey) {
        Integer existingId = idempotentCreates.get(idempotencyKey);
        if (existingId != null) {

    if (hasKey && response.getStatusCode() == HttpStatus.CREATED
        && response.getBody() != null && response.getBody().getId() != null) {
        idempotentCreates.putIfAbsent(idempotencyKey, response.getBody().getId());
    }
    return response;
